product_metadata.title: T-fal Textiles Kitchen Towel, 2 Pack, Peppers
features: Pure personality. T-fal’s Fiber Reactive Print Kitchen Towels come in spirited designs that add distinct decorative punch to an industrious kitchen staple.
Fully functional. Generously sized 16 in. by 28 in. (40 cm by 71 cm) towels are finely crafted from plush 100% cotton to be highly absorbent which makes clean-up a snap.
Everlasting vibrancy. T-fal’s fiber-reactive printing process treats yarns to completely absorb dye, ensuring vivid tones and design integrity endures.
The perfect compliment. Towels coordinate with T-fal Textiles’ entire line of dish cloths, heat protection, and more.
Easy care. Machine wash and dry.
description: Shake up your kitchen cleaning essentials with these charismatic companions that are as diligent as they are decorative. T-fal’s Fiber Reactive Print Kitchen Towel Sets boast charming graphics that liven up a space, with each towel well crafted from 100% absorbent cotton to handle washing, wiping, and drying with minimal effort. A fastidious fiber reactive printing process is employed to specially treat yarns to absorb dyes completely, ensuring colors won’t fade and designs remain crystal clear. Machine wash and dry.
